# CRYPTOCOCCUS NEOFORMANS

Consult Infectious Diseases.

## Duration of antimicrobial therapy

Duration of therapy is dependent upon location and severity of infection, and response to therapy. Consult Infectious Diseases for more information.

References:

- Mandell chapter: Cryptococcosis (Cryptococcus neoformans and Cryptococcus gattii)
- Perfect et al. Clinical Infectious Diseases 2010, (50) 291-322
- Sanford keyword: Cryptococcus
Therapy:
## Treatment of mild to moderate infection outside of the central nervous system or step-down treatment once disease has stabilized

Fluconazole 400 mg PO q24h ($) [R,DI]
<OR>
Itraconazole 200 mg PO q12h ($) [DI]

## Treatment of central nervous system infection or severe infection outside central nervous system

Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases, recommended combination therapy with flucytosine requires ID approval Amphotericin B Liposomal (Ambisome) 3-5 mg/kg IV q24h ($$$$) [R,O]
<AND>
flucytosine 25 mg/kg PO q6h ($$$$$) [R,O]
(Reminder: for Ampho B add NS 500 ml hydration BEFORE & AFTER.)

## Outpatient or step-down treatment once disease has stabilized

Fluconazole 400 mg PO QDay ($) [R,DI]
<OR>
Itraconazole 200 mg PO BID ($) [DI]
